purpose: Provide a button-ready, Streamlit-free orchestration result that stops before optimization for invalid, structurally unidentified, boundary, or unavailable finite-CMLE designs while retaining bilingual reasons, next actions, and machine-readable stage evidence.

workflow_contract.entrypoint: A new Streamlit-free run_cmle_calibration_workflow function accepts the same design/fit inputs as fit_cmle and returns one stable result schema for success and all blocked states.
workflow_contract.early_stop: input_invalid and design_not_identified do not call the existence oracle or optimizer; finite_mle_boundary/unavailable do not call the optimizer; only an oracle-qualified interior reaches fit_cmle.
workflow_contract.fit_safety: The interior route calls the existing default-gated fit_cmle path. The workflow must not disable or replace the fit-level finite-MLE gate, even though this deliberately repeats the audit in v1.
workflow_contract.technical_boundary_output: No technical parameter table is created on an early-stopped boundary; the separate direct fit_cmle research path continues to retain technical values for audit comparability.
workflow_contract.bilingual: Every stage and terminal result includes stable Japanese and English headline, explanation, and next-action text; status codes remain language-neutral.
workflow_contract.machine_readable: Return terminal summary, ordered stages, design audit, existence audit when reached, fit only when attempted, output availability, and elapsed-time evidence.
workflow_contract.no_fallback: Never switch to JMLE, MML, a prior, penalty, correction, clamping, or reduced design.

registered_checks.fixtures: Replay all 93 registered existence fixtures. Two structural controls stop at design, 43 boundary controls stop before optimization, and 48 interior controls reach optimization; terminal state agrees with the frozen oracle classification.
registered_checks.retained: Replay all same-byte 350 topology-anchor cases. Expected: 63 design_not_identified, 13 finite_mle_boundary, 274 optimization attempts, and 274 calibration_ready under the frozen evidence.
registered_checks.optimizer_skip_probe: Monkeypatch the optimizer entrypoint to raise if called and prove that boundary, unavailable, and structural cases return normally without invoking it.
registered_checks.oracle_skip_probe: Monkeypatch the oracle to raise if called and prove that structurally blocked designs do not invoke it.
registered_checks.numeric_invariance: For every retained calibration_ready case, structural estimates, SE, conditional likelihood, readiness, and anchor values match the readiness-integration evidence within the registered tolerances.
registered_checks.schema: Every terminal status returns the same top-level keys and a four-row ordered stage table; unavailable downstream artifacts are represented explicitly, not omitted ambiguously.
registered_checks.language: Japanese and English messages are nonempty and status codes are identical across language selection.

success_gates.retained_accounting: 350/350 with 63 design blocks, 13 boundary stops, 274 optimization attempts, and 274 ready results
success_gates.tests: All selected CMLE, existence, anchor, and new structured-workflow tests pass.

interpretation_limits.duplicate_audit: The v1 interior path repeats the support audit inside fit_cmle for defense in depth; later deduplication requires a design-identity contract and separate prospective evidence.
interpretation_limits.person_scoring: The v1 workflow reports downstream Person scoring as available/not-run but does not yet perform WLE or Person fit.
interpretation_limits.bilingual_review: Programmatic nonempty messages are not a comprehension study.
interpretation_limits.cross_engine: No equivalence with immer, TAM, sirt, or mfrmr is implied.
interpretation_limits.public_ui: withheld pending cross-engine boundary replay and comprehension testing
